overview_description.description:
DreamNotes is a mobile application that enables people to share their dreams online. On average, we spend 25 years sleeping, 6 of which are filled with dreams. For many people, dreams hold a special power. Some believe they have meanings or foretell the future. Dreams can also be very amusing and fun to share with others.

Most people only remember their dreams in detail for a few minutes after waking up. By being available on a mobile phone, DreamNotes makes it easy to record the details of a dream before the day starts and the dream is forgotten. Using DreamNotes, a person can type in their dream or create an audio recording. The dream will then be available via the website or the mobile app.
